svg.title: Raj Patel — case R204570
svg.desc: An animated MRI viewer: a scanner line sweeps an axial brain slice and reveals a BraTS-coloured segmentation labelled "curiosity (enhancing)". Beside it, a radiology report for Raj Patel, AI engineer in Ahmedabad.
svg.text: AI engineer · agentic systems · medical imaging

text.tspan: builds agents that actually use tools
trains models that see inside skulls
ships to prod, not just to main
